# ui-playground commands

Every `ui-playground` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `ui-playground:funds-tick`

Assign a fresh demo funds value to the newest lead(s) via the ORM update path (auto-publishes the live-grid invalidation).

```bash
bin/semitexa ui-playground:funds-tick
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--id` | yes |
| `--count` | yes |

## `ui-playground:seed-leads`

Seed deterministic demo leads for the /ui-playground/admin/leads grid (idempotent; safe to re-run).

```bash
bin/semitexa ui-playground:seed-leads
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--count` | yes |
| `--fresh-demo-data` | no |
